  • Constructor Details

    • Burst

      public Burst(Double probability, DistributionContainer distrContA, DistributionContainer distrContB, Boolean isRoundRobin) throws IncorrectDistributionParameterException
      Creates a new Burst distribution with the specified probability of having events of type A. distrContA is the DistributionContainer containing the length distribution A and the related parameters, while distrContB is the same of distrContA but for distribution B.
      Parameters:
      probability - the probability of having events of type A
      distrContA - the DistributionContainer containing the length distribution A and the related parameter
      distrContB - the DistributionContainer containing the length distribution A and the related parameter
      isRoundRobin - if true, the behavior of the interval change is set to Round-Robin. That is, there is a pure alternation of the interval types, starting with interval A: A-B-A-B-A-B-A-B... In this case, the probability parameter is ignored. If false, the interval type is changed according to the probability parameter
      Throws:
      IncorrectDistributionParameterException - if the probability is not a value comprised between 0 and 1

    • dispatch

      protected void dispatch(NetMessage message) throws NetException
      Message dispatcher for Burst distribution. When an EVENT_DISTRIBUTION_CHANGE message arrives, it chooses the new interval type based on the probability and sends to itself a new EVENT_DISTRIBUTION_CHANGE message with a delay generated by the chosen interval. Otherwise it discards the message, if it is set to discard.
      Overrides:
      dispatch in class NetNode
      Throws:
      NetException
